environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. AWS WAF v2 WebACL is attached to the ALB with three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 100 in COUNT mode for baseline telemetry, (2) a custom rule group 'corp-input-validation' at priority 200 containing a single RegexPatternSet rule matching request query string parameters against pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|'\s*or\s+'|'\s*and\s+'|extractvalue|load_file|benchmark\s*\()` with action BLOCK and label 'corp:sqli:query-param', (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet at priority 300 with all rules in BLOCK mode including SQLi_QUERYARGUMENTS, SQLi_BODY, and SQLi_COOKIE inspection. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ECS task role has no network egress policy (tasks can reach the internet), and CloudWatch Logs receives WAF sampled requests.

config.infrastructure: AWS ALB -> ECS Fargate (Amazon Linux 2023 container)
config.waf_rule_priority_200: Custom rule group 'corp-input-validation' - RegexPatternSet on QueryString - BLOCK
config.network: Public ALB, private subnet for tasks, NAT gateway for egress
